entities.summary: Richard Alfred Mayela Páez Monzón known as Richard Páez is a Venezuelan football manager. He is the current manager of Colombian club Cúcuta Deportivo and formerly coached Ecuadorian Serie A club Deportivo Cuenca as well as the Venezuela national football team.
